test_title: PYST 55: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that best expresses the meaning of the underlined idiom.

Christy should discuss this with her __face to face__.

options.text: With another person in their presence rather than, say, by phone or letter
Come to fully accept or understand something

solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **face to face:** Direct interaction (आमने-सामने)

 
 
• **Example**: Negotiations are more effective when done face to face.
 
 
 
• **With another person in their presence rather than, say, by phone or letter: **(फोन या पत्र के बजाय किसी की उपस्थिति में) - Interacting with someone physically present. Example: It's crucial to apologize face to face rather than through a text message.
 
• This option encapsulates direct, physical interaction, which is the essence of the idiom.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'With another person in their presence rather than, say, by phone or letter'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Come to fully accept or understand something:** (कुछ समझने या स्वीकार करने में समय लगना) - Gradually understanding and accepting a situation or fact.
 
• **Remained normal and realistic:** (वास्तविकता के साथ बने रहना) - Staying grounded despite various circumstances.
 
• **Almost always: **(ज्यादातर समय) - Happening very frequently.

40:Ta26,

The correct answer is 'Option 2' i.e. **'exceptional mastery'.**
